Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MILESTONE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money to Milestone Community Development for a cybersecurity training program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MILESTONE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Milestone Community Development for the Milestone Tech Cybersecurity Training Program in partnership with Saint Mary University. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Milestone Community Development for the Milestone Tech Cybersecurity Training Program in partnership with Saint Mary University. This is a onetime appropriation.
